key_features: High-Performance Dedicated DAC: Decodes digital signals smoothly up to 24bit/48KHz for high-fidelity audio reproduction without compression.
Premium Aluminum Connectors: Heavy-duty metal housings resist crushing, structural distortion, and wear from daily plugging cycles.
Reinforced Braided Exterior: Built to endure rigorous bend testing thousands of times without tearing, fraying, or tangling.
Universal Inline Control Support: Seamlessly passes through microphone signals and inline button commands for calls and media navigation.
